tools.name: bitbucket_pulls
tools.description: Pull requests, most recently updated first, with state, branches and reviewers. owner and name come from the git remote.

state.description: Default open. closed covers merged, declined and superseded.

tools.name: bitbucket_pull_files
tools.description: The files a pull request changes, with status, line counts and any old path. Name paths for their diffs; a long diff comes in parts, with a note on the rest.

paths.description: Only these files, each with its patch.

offset.description: Patch line to start from, from 0. The note gives the next one.

lines.description: Patch lines to return. Default 400, at most 1000; a patch also stops at 32 KB.

tools.name: bitbucket_comments
tools.description: What people wrote on a pull request, oldest first.

tools.name: bitbucket_pipelines
tools.description: Recent Pipelines runs, newest first, with status and conclusion.

tools.name: bitbucket_pipeline
tools.description: One pipeline with its steps and their status, to see which step failed.

tools.name: bitbucket_step_log
tools.description: The end of one pipeline step's log. Start with the default tail or grep for the error. truncated means earlier lines were left out.

tail.description: Lines from the end, after grep. Default 200, at most 2000.

grep.description: Only lines containing this, ignoring case.
